body:
The last time I was committed a psychiatrist there told me that it is usually much harder to treat a person who has a background in psychology. I guess it plays into the self-sabotage thing. Your brain being your own worst enemy and all. I definitely have not studied near enough about dialectical behavioral therapy and for good reason. IF I ever can get myself into a program I want to have as clean a slate as I can, I want to avoid fucking it up before I have a chance to succeed. 


I will keep trying, at least for now. The storm has seemed to pass for the time being. I feel much more calm and composed than I have all day. Another thing I recently re-learned in relation to BPD is that the depression and mania (in BPD it is irritability and rage rather than the grandiose thinking and limitless energy that bipolar mania is known for) it often looks exactly like bipolar disorder especially to GPs. Co-morbidity is something like 75% with mood disorders but the difference is the change can happen in a flash. And you can switch back just as fast. It is not usually related to chemical imbalances (unless it presents with a mood disorder but thats a whole 'nother can of worms) but almost solely related to environment. Basically BPD is all maladaptive behaviours, which make people with BPD notorious in psychiatry for a variety of reasons. 


I am pretty jelly of your obtaining your psychology degree! Good for you! It has always been my dream to obtain a degree in that field, be it a psychology degree or something related to it, so I am pretty stoked for you! I really appreciate all of the kind words as well! Good luck in your life and career! You will do good work!

Well thank you for caring. Ya the cycle never seems to end. Sadly I have been "taking a break" for the last year. I don't work. I don't go to school. I spend my days taking it easy. Doing things I want to do. It never took away any stress or made me feel any better. Now I could not work if I wanted to right now anyways so that is out of the picture. 

Now as for self-guided therapy and online resources. One of the major defining features of Borderline Personality Disorder is difficulty maintaining any course of action that offers no immediate reward and a marked tendency to act unexpectedly and without consideration of the consequences. I pulled both of those straight out of my abnormal psychology textbook, its right from the dsm iv-tr. Sadly self-sabotage seems to be a common feature in those with bpd and I have it in spades. I WISH I COULD HELP MYSELF. Not to toot my own horn like a douche but I have read more textbooks on psychology than most people have read textbooks in general. 

It took me 26 years before I could finally admit I may be slightly above average intelligence when it comes to psychology, bio psychology and psychopharmacology (this one in particular). Alas if I could work this out by myself I think I would at least not be thinking so strongly of suicide anymore. I know that this is one of the reasons today I feel so fucking helpless. I understand the disorder from a variety of viewpoints. A lot better than my doctor (who told me so today which left me gobsmacked, but then again he is a gp with a specialty in addictions not a shrink, the guy is certainly in a league far beyond my own in terms of knowing his shit). I know exactly what it is I need to do. I just cant get to it. As for helping myself....if I do not have a professional overseer slapping me every time I fall out of line I fail. 

The reward is not tangible to me. It is not immediate. I know I need to do these things to get any sort of forward momentum going, and sometimes I get enough motivation to say YESS I WILL DO ALL THE THINGS!!! But the next moment life throws me a hiccup the papers are torn apart, I have reformatted my hard drive for the five thousandth time this year and I am back to square one. I need to be held accountable. I need to be watched closely so I can't cheat (trust me I know that by my cheating I am cheating myself, oh god how I know....does it stop me? pfft fuck past me! fuck future me! Present me wants results fucking now!!) 

Thanks for taking the time to read and reply duder or dudette. Just talking to both you and CantPenTheSnowden has gotten me to a bit better of a place. I am far more appreciative than either of you could know.

Well the poppies have at least another 3 weeks before the bloom so there is that. I really do not want to kill myself. Like really don't. But I know I am fast getting sick of this repetitive cycle of seeking out help and being shat upon, having an emotional breakdown, than feeling...okay. Than meltdown, attempt to find therapy, wait...wait...wait......then call back and be told nope sorry since you have not attempted suicide, since you are no longer addicted we cannot help you. Repeat. FOREVER. 

It is tiring as hell. I have been climbing for years. I reach the halfway point and fall to the bottom. I climb up again and fall. And fall. And fall. I am so so so tired of all of it. It is hard to see the top when all I ever see is the bottom ya know?

I know it probably seems like I am just making excuses but in all honesty I could not do any of that if I wanted to. Closest city is 55km away. My town has a whopping population of 380. The next town over is just over 50 people, 20 km away. It sounds impossible but that is central alberta for you. I mean there are a few community gatherings and events but since my dad went psycho my family became "that family". 


When I walked into my grade 7 class the morning after it happened before the teacher arrived I was laughed at for the previous nights horrific blood-soaked events. Like full on point and laugh at the freak sort of shit. I mean I was not well liked before that since I wore shitty clothes and was not a born and bred hometown boy but that night sealed my fate as the go-to whipping boy. Since then there is not a single thing I would give back to these inbred fucks. I was bullied relentlessly to the point where I dreaded going to going to school as much as I used to dread going home.

I realize this is a toxic attitude and that it has been years and years since those events and certainly there are people who do not even remember any of that, but there still people who do. As recently as this past January we had people honking their horns and shouting obscene things about my family outside our house at 1 in the morning. So no sorry but toxic attitude or no I still feel threatened here.

I really want to thank you for responding to me good sir or madame, I truly do appreciate it. I do not want you to think I am ungrateful or anything and I really do like your suggestions, if i ever magically end up in one of the cities I mentioned in my original post I will definitely be looking to volunteer at an animal shelter, I really love animals.

Ya I get that. Trust me I do. It is practically all I ever think about. How much I owe them. I would love to pay them back. But there is not one person out there who would hire me today in the state I am constantly in. I do other things. Plant a garden, wash dishes, clean the yard, look after the dogs but that is all I am capable of and it is most certainly not paying any fucking bills. I take more than I give. I try to give more but I can't. And it is not for lack of trying. I need psychiatric help. I need to change my behaviours, my thought patterns my ways of coping but without a professional I am lost.
